				<div id="post-4809" class="post-4809 page type-page status-publish hentry">
			<span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">About Us</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/author/tracy/" rel="author">tracy</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2024-07-03T14:27:11-04:00</span>																		<div class="post-content">
				<header>
<h1>Welcome to Kite Beach Inn &#8211; Cabarete, D.R.</h1>
</header>
<p>Kite Beach Inn is a 26-room <strong>beachfront hotel</strong> located directly on <strong>Kite Beach</strong> in <strong>Cabarete. </strong>We are located on the North Coast of the Dominican Republic. Kites can be launched on Kite Beach directly off our property. You can also take kiteboarding lessons with IKO certified kiteboarding schools close by.</p>
<p>At Kite Beach Inn, you have the easiest and most direct access to Kite Beach. We are a value-oriented hotel with clean and comfortable rooms. We have free wifi throughout our property. Kite Beach Inn also provides a casual and friendly environment where you can make friends easily.  Many guests enjoy stand up paddle board and surfing in the morning, and kiteboarding in the afternoon. Guests also enjoy the vibrant Cabarete nightlife located along the beach in downtown Cabarete.</p>
<p>Kite Beach Inn provides modern amenities for a relaxed and comfortable stay. We have lounge chairs around the pool and on our wood deck. You can connect to the real world via free high speed internet.  There are 3 restaurants within a 3-minute walk. Kite Beach Inn has a diesel back-up generator for 24/7 electrical service, hot water, on-site security, maid service and paid laundry service.</p>
<p>The hotel reception can arrange taxi service, book lessons and tours for our guests. We pride ourselves in providing excellent customer service because we understand happy guests mean good word-of-mouth and repeat guests.</p>
<p>If you are looking for the best and most affordable <strong>ocean front hotel</strong> in Cabarete for kiteboarding, Kite Beach Inn is for you. Please <a href="https://www.kitebeachinn.com/booking">book on-line</a>, e-mail us at info@kitebeachinn.com, contact us at +1 (809) 490-5517 WhatsApp or call 1 (809) 571-0695 (English/Español) today to make your reservations. We look forwards to meeting you.</p>
<p><strong>Kite Beach Inn on Google Map</strong></p>
